title: Head of Cloud Infrastructure
desc: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B. We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces . We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle , Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency. About The Role: We are hiring a Head of Cloud Infrastructure (Director Level) to lead the modernization and scaling of the shared infrastructure that powers YipitData’s data-intensive products and engineering organization. Reporting to the Chief Architect, you will own cloud platform, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, and developer experience across an AWS environment built with Kubernetes and Terraform. This is a player-coach leadership role for someone who can set strategy, make sound architectural decisions, remain technically credible, and lead a high-leverage global team. You will unify existing modernization initiatives into a coherent roadmap, establish formal reliability and disaster-recovery practices, and make it faster and easier for engineers to build, deploy, and operate dependable software. As the platform matures, you will also improve cloud efficiency and deliver measurable savings without compromising reliability or developer velocity. You will own shared infrastructure, while our Data Platform, Data Engineering, and application teams will continue to own their applications and data products. Security and Enterprise IT are outside this role’s ownership, and you will partner closely with those functions as well as the Chief Architect and engineering leaders. This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. We expect US working hours with sufficient overlap to lead and collaborate with a globally distributed team. This role does not require travel. As Our Head of Cloud Infrastructure You Will: Set and execute a prioritized cloud-infrastructure modernization roadmap, bringing existing initiatives together into a clear strategy for AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and the broader platform ecosystem. Lead a small, high-leverage global team spanning cloud platform, SRE, and DevOps, combining clear direction and coaching with hands-on technical judgment. Improve developer velocity and platform experience by delivering reliable paved roads, reusable infrastructure capabilities, self-service workflows, and faster feedback loops. Establish and mature formal reliability practices, including service ownership, SLIs and SLOs, incident management, error-budget practices, observability, and accountable post-incident follow-through. Own disaster-recovery strategy and readiness, including recovery objectives, testing, automation, and the closure of identified resilience gaps. Design a sustainable 24/7 operational model, including on-call responsibilities, escalation paths, incident leadership, and healthy collaboration across a global team. Partner with the Chief Architect and engineering leaders to define platform priorities, clarify ownership boundaries, and help application and data teams operate their workloads effectively on shared infrastructure. title: VP of Engineering, Product Platform
desc: VP of Engineering, Product Platform Squarespace is looking for a VP of Software Engineering to lead our Product Platform organization. Product Platform exists to solve the problems that cut across every product team so those teams can ship better products, faster. Your customers are internal: the product teams taking Squarespace to market. What you own is the layer underneath them, spanning identity and access, user accounts, our design system, media, communications, APIs and service frameworks, the external developer environment, and the shared AI capabilities behind our newest products. This is a platform-as-product leadership role - your mission is to consolidate overlapping capabilities, drive adoption of shared foundations, and turn the platform into a source of velocity and product quality. We’re looking for someone who is excited to grow a leadership team, and who has demonstrated experience operating as a close partner to infrastructure, product management and commercial teams. This position reports to Squarespace’s President and is based in NYC (3x/week hybrid). You’ll Get To… Own the multi-year product strategy for Squarespace's product platform capabilities, from identity and accounts to design systems, communications, media, and developer-facing APIs Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineering managers across multiple platform domains Define what "platform as a product" means in practice: adoption metrics, internal customer feedback loops, intake and prioritization mechanisms, and clear service expectations Drive consolidation of fragmented and overlapping systems while sustaining delivery for the product teams that depend on them Shape the external developer experience — public APIs, documentation, and extensibility — as a growth surface, not just an integration layer Partner with product, design, security, and data leadership on architecture, sequencing, and investment trade-offs Influence company-level product planning so platform investments are shaped with the business, not downstream of it Who We’re Looking For 15+ years of engineering management experience, including leading engineering teams and developing technical leaders Deep experience in platform engineering management: internal platforms, developer platforms, or shared services adopted by multiple product teams — you've owned adoption as a success metric, not just delivery Fluency in at least some of this role's domains: identity/auth, design systems, APIs and extensibility, notifications/communications, or account experiences Track record of driving consolidation or modernization across fragmented systems without stalling the teams that depend on them Strong technical judgment; comfortable in architecture conversations with senior engineers while staying firmly in the product seat Executive presence: you can make platform investment legible and compelling to a CPO, CFO, and board-level audience Experience balancing internal customers, external developers, and end-user impact in one portfolio Benefits & Perks A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans Fertility and adoption benefits Headspace mindfulness app subscription Global Employee Assistance Program Retirement benefits with employer match Flexible paid time off 12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave Pretax commuter benefit Education reimbursement Employee donation match to community organizations 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) Dog-friendly workplace Free lunch and snacks Private rooftop Hack week twice per year US Cash Compensation Range Cash Compensation Range: $375,000 - $450,000 USD The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.
